output.summary: A deciduous scrambling shrub native from Europe to the Caucasus and northwestern Africa. It has long curved thorns and fragrant pink flowers, followed by soft hips rich in vitamin C. In Turkey, the hips have traditionally been made into marmalade, syrup, jam, tea and jelly.
output.edibilityNote: In Turkey, the hips have traditionally been collected in winter and processed into marmalade, syrup, jam, tea and jelly.
